chapterInfo.content:
4
Ɔdɔfoɔ no ahoɔfɛ
1 # Nmd 5.12; 6.5 Hwɛ, wo ho yɛ fɛ, me dɔfoɔ,
hwɛ, wo ho yɛ fɛ,
na w’aniwa yɛ aborɔnoma ani,
w’anim nkatanim mu.
Wo nwi te sɛ mmirekyikuo
a wɔsiane wɔ Gilead bepɔ ho.
2 # Nmd 6.6 Wo se te sɛ nnwanten bereɛ
a wɔatwitwa wɔn nwi a wɔfiri adwareeɛ
a wɔn nyinaa awowo ntanta,
na deɛ wabu kyene nni wɔn mu.
3 # Nmd 6.7 W’anofafa te sɛ koogyan homa,
na w’anomu kasa yɛ dɛ.
W’asontorɔ mu te sɛ atoaa aba fa,
w’anim nkatanimu mu.
4 # Nmd 7.4 Wo kɔn si so teateawa
sɛ Dawid abantenten
a akyɛm nketenkete apem sensɛne ho,
ne nyinaa yɛ nnɔmmarima akyɛm.
5 # Nmd 7.3 Wo nufo mmienu
te sɛ atweburuwa nta
a wɔdidi sukooko mu.
6 # Nmd 2.17 Mɛkɔ kurobo bepɔ
ne ohwamfufuo kokoɔ no so
akɔsi sɛ onwunu bɛdwoɔ,
na sunsum bɛyera.
7 # Dwom 45.13 Wo ho nyinaa yɛ fɛ, me dɔfoɔ,
na ɛdɛm biara nni wo ho.
8M’ayeforɔ, ɛne me mfiri Lebanon,
ɛne me mfiri Lebanon nkɔ,
na yɛmfiri Amana atifi,
Senir ne Hermon atifi,
agyata tenabea, asebɔ mmepɔ so, nhwɛ fam.
9Woakye m’akoma, me nuabaa, m’ayeforɔ,
wode w’aniwa a wode hwɛɛ me no afa m’akoma
ne wo kɔn mu ntweaban baako.
10Sɛdeɛ wo dɔ si yɛ dɛ, me nuabaa, m’ayeforɔ,
sɛdeɛ wo dɔ si yɛ dɛ sene nsa,
na wo sradehwam hwa sene duhwam biara.
11W’ano sosɔ ɛwomono, m’ayeforɔ,
ɛwoɔ ne nufosuo wɔ wo tɛkyerɛma ase,
na wo ntadeɛ mu hwa te sɛ Lebanon hwa.
12Me nuabaa, m’ayeforɔ yɛ turo a woato ano pono mu,
nsuo aniwa a wɔasi ano kwan, ne asubura a wɔasɔ ano.
13Wo mman yɛ atoaa aba
ne nnuaba a ɛwɔ boɔ turo,
ahuahaa ne nnuannua ahodoɔ,
14nnuannua ne nkuto, bɛwewonua ne pɛprɛ
ne ohwamfufuo nnua nyinaa,
kurobo ne dupapo
ne nnuhwam atitire nyinaa;
15nturo mu asubura, mmasuo aniwa
ne nsuwansuwa a ɛfiri Lebanon so sene.
16Atifi fam mframa, sɔre,
na anafoɔ mframa nso,
bra bɛbɔ me turo mu,
ma ne nnuhwam nsosɔ.
Ma me dɔfoɔ mmra ne turo mu,
na ɔnni mu nnuaba a ɛwɔ boɔ no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
